notes: Closest to the reference: Token helper methods are used in every structural check, including the HasSuffix and anonymous-block paths; its tests cover the dispenser, the parser (error-only checks) and adapt output for both braces.

Closely mirrors the reference with helper methods, covering the HasSuffix and anonymous-block checks (the helpers lack doc comments); tests cover the dispenser, parse and adapt paths, though the parse test only checks for no error.

Clean Token-method helpers applied at nearly every structural brace check, matching the reference; it leaves the site-address `HasSuffix("{")` check without a quoted exemption and keeps quoted "{}" in the special branch, but has good parse and adapt integration tests.

Adds clean documented isBlockOpen/isBlockClose token helpers and uses them at nearly every structural brace check, but leaves the quoted-address HasSuffix '{' check unchanged; good parser and integration adapt tests.

Correct fix covering the dispenser, addresses (including the HasSuffix check), the `{}` refinement, imports and blockTokens; the inline `&& !Quoted()` repetition is verbose and the anonymous-block check in doImport was missed, but the tests are thorough and verify tokens.

Correct fix that also covers the HasSuffix and quoted '{}' cases, but repeats `&& !Quoted()` inline instead of using a helper and misses the 'anonymous blocks' check in doImport; strong token-level dispenser, parser and adapter tests.

Clean, minimal change that keeps all same-module import blocks and so fixes the reported issue in all same-module variants, but it still deduplicates parent vs child at the ConfigResource level, silently dropping child imports of other instances.

Keeps every import block declared in the same module, so the reported for_each case and module-instance targets work, but it dedupes parent and child at the whole-resource level, so a child-module import for a different instance is still silently dropped (unlike the reference's instance-level dedup).

Fixes the reported root-level for_each case and handles parent/child overrides per instance, but the new same-module override logic drops valid blocks: dynamic for_each imports, and module-instance targets such as module.m[0].x vs module.m[1].x, because it ignores module keys. It also changes transform_config.go and configs, which the fix did not need.

Its static-address dedup fixes the reported for_each case and parent/child instance overrides, but it strips module instance keys, so root blocks targeting module.x[0].r and module.x[1].r still collide and one is silently dropped; it also adds unneeded changes in configs and transform_config.

Keeps all same-module blocks for a resource, which fixes the reported case, but a parent block still drops every child-module block for the same resource regardless of instance; it also leaves an unused FindImportStatements that returns only the first statement.

Groups same-module blocks per resource, which fixes the reported case, but parent/child override is still whole-resource; it also leaves a vestigial FindImportStatements that keeps only the first block, and uses an awkward nested rescan of the module's imports.
No changes were made, so the bug remains.
Empty patch; the bug is not addressed.
